📥 Farm Data Backup

Your records and photos live only in this browser. Download a backup regularly and keep a safe copy. Backups include your photos, so the file can be large. They never include your AI key or PIN.

Restoring a backup replaces the current records. Download a backup first.

📷 Tree Photos & AI Check

Photograph a tree or crop regularly. The AI compares the photo with earlier ones, your irrigation and fertiliser records and the local weather, and warns you early about problems.

🔒 View-only mode. Unlock with the owner PIN to add photos or run the AI check.

Photo timeline

⚙️ Settings

📍 Farm location (for weather)

☁️ Cloud sync

One-time setup guide (free, about 10 minutes)
  1. Go to console.firebase.google.com and sign in with Google. Click Add project, name it (e.g. my-farm) and finish. Google Analytics is not needed.
  2. Open Build → Authentication → Get started. Under Sign-in method switch on Email/Password. Then open the Users tab and click Add user: type your email and a strong password. This is your sync login.
  3. In Authentication → Settings → User actions, untick Enable create (sign-up) so nobody else can make an account.
  4. Open Build → Firestore Database → Create database. Choose production mode and the location asia-south1 (Mumbai). The location can't be changed later.
  5. Open the Firestore Rules tab, replace everything with the rules below, and click Publish.
  6. Click the gear icon → Project settings → General → Your apps, tap the web icon </>, register an app, and copy the firebaseConfig block. Paste it below and tap Save, then sign in with your email and password.
  7. Repeat step 6's last part on your other devices: paste the same config and sign in.
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /farms/{uid} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }
    match /farms/{uid}/photos/{pid} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }
  }
}

Records and photos are saved to your own private Firebase project and merged between your devices, newest edit wins. The Firebase config is not a secret; your data is protected by your login and the rules above. Free plan limits are far above what one farm uses.

🤖 AI assistant (for photo analysis)

Get a key at console.anthropic.com (API billing is separate from the Claude app). The key is saved only in this browser and sent only to Anthropic. Create a key with a low spending limit and never use it on a shared device. Photos you analyse are sent to Anthropic. The key is never included in backups.

🔐 Owner PIN

The PIN stops other people from adding or changing records on this device. If you forget it, use Forgot PIN? on the unlock screen with your recovery code. It is a convenience lock, not bank-grade security.
